_comment: Interactive room objects (docs/room_authoring.md §4). Pixels and seconds. Every number here is live-editable with F1.

boulder._comment: game/objects/boulder.gd: wired trap that drops and rolls at the player. Rolling into the player faster than impact_speed (px/s along the contact) hits them; pinned against a wall it crushes (objects.crush). friction = Coulomb coefficient on its sides (player.json surface_max_press caps the press).

crush._comment: Design §7.6, game/combat/crush.gd. A character a moving solid squeezes is displaced up to max_displace px to the nearest free spot and hit (player and enemies alike); with no spot the player voids out and an enemy dies.

explosive._comment: game/combat/explosive.gd. The charge drops to the floor under gravity; the second use detonates it. Blast: a radius px circle; damage to enemies, switches and breakable walls in it (tier 0 — fortified walls hold); player_damage to the player if their body centre is inside.

darts._comment: Wooden darts: straight (no gravity), stop at the first thing they hit. Passing through anything on the fire layer sets one burning; a burning dart's hit carries fire: true.

fire._comment: Burning. An enemy hit by fire burns for enemy_burn_time s, losing enemy_burn_damage HP every enemy_burn_tick s (no stagger). A burnable barrier burns for barrier_burn_time s, then is gone for good.

grapple._comment: assist_deg: a shot that would hit nothing to latch or pull aims itself at the nearest grapple anchor (the dedicated latch points only — never a pullable block or a switch) within this many degrees of the aim, in range and in sight.
